reason: User requests bounded 48-query audit instead; no new labels or predictions have been computed

approximation: This is a deterministic-subset posterior REPLAY, not bitwise original champion. The full original replay differs from archive by maxTV 0.0002738557673308919 on original queries. Report subset interleaved-half and per-chain mean TV differences, not a rigorous Monte Carlo bound.
old_stress: Additionally score pre-frozen stress120's 60 zero/readout-local cases. The other 60 are unsupported nonlocal interface cases, not in-scope failures.
label_order: Freeze explicit query JSON and hashes, then freeze both predictors' outputs, then open private model for exact true labels.
checks: Hash-check recovered sources and frozen weakfit, exact transfer vs independent dense transfer and spin-flip identity on all 48 cold queries; native vs generic transfer on predetermined subset queries.
uncertainty: Posterior spread conditional on public data, assumed likelihood/prior, and approximate chains; not proof of irreducible finite-data uncertainty, calibrated coverage, or failure of all algorithms. No fitting, score-driven selection, or recovered-science edits.
